title: PROGRAMME_2 THE SCHOOL
subject: social-studies
text:
1 ” to allow audio playback THE SCHOOL [ Music] Hello Learner, welcome to social studies for grade 4. Today we are going to learn about the school. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program. [Music]

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. Today we are going to learn about the school. We shall learn what the school motto and core values are and tell our school daily routine. First let us remind ourselves what we learnt in the previous lesson. In the previous lesson we learnt about culture. What is culture? # Bell # Good Culture is the way of life of people in a community. How do you show your culture? # Bell # I hope your answers include; The food we eat. The way we dress. The houses we live in Through festivals and ceremonies performed in the community. We also learnt the importance of culture. Do you remember? State some of them. # Bell # Good. I hope your answers include; It identifies who we are. It is a tourist attraction. and We learn a lot about other people's culture. It helps us to live in peace with each other and respect each other. What is a school? # Bell # Do you go to school? # Bell # Are you in school today? # Bell # A school is an educational institution designed to provide learning environments for the teaching of Learners under the direction and supervision of teachers. What is the name of your school? # Bell # In which county is your school? # Bell # Does your school have a school motto? # Bell # A school motto is a short statement that shows the aims of a school. Examples of school motto are; 1. tudy for service, study for service. 2. Diligence rewards, diligence rewards. 3. Strive for excellence, strive for excellence 4. Cooperate for succes, cooperate for succes, A school motto helps in motivating us to achieve our goals What is your school motto? What is your school motto? # Bell #

3 ” to allow audio playback Core values on the other hand are guiding beliefs which help us to do the right things in the school. Examples of values that help us to do the right things in school are; 1) Responsibility. 2) Respect. 3) Excellence. 4) Care and compassion. 5) Understanding. 6) Trustworthiness. 7) Honesty. 8) Tolerance. 9) Being ethical What are the core values in your school? # Bell # Let us discuss some of the values we have just mentioned above Honesty. What is honesty? # Bell # Honesty means telling the truth all the time. When you are honest you will avoid telling lies. Learner, are you honest? Are you honest? # Bell # Another value is responsibility. In school we show responsibility by doing school work, c leaning the classrooms. cleaning the school compound and other duties given to us without being reminded. How do we show responsibility at home? # Bell # At home we show responsibility by doing our homework, taking care of animals washing our clothes and sweeping the house among other duties. Another value is respect. Learner , how do we show respect? # Bell # We show respect by; being polite when you talk to your elders parents teachers and friends. standing attention when raising the national flag. How else do we show respect? # Bell # We should respect our parents, elders, teachers and friends. What are the core values of your school? What are the core values of your school? # Bell # What do you do to practice the motto and core values of your school? What do you do to practice the mortal and core values of your school? # Bell # Lastly a school daily routine is a program of activities done in the school on every school day. It ensures that each activity is given enough time and all the day's activities in the school are ran smoothly. What is your first activity in your school on Monday? What is your first activity in your school on Monday? # Bell #

4 ” to allow audio playback What time do the activities begin? What time do the activities begin? # Bell # How long does the activity take? How long does the activity take? # Bell # School routines enable has to learn smoothly and well. We also become disciplined by following the school routine. To conclude the lesson, share your school routine with your parents or guardians. Let them share with you their school routine too when they were in school. That brings us to the end of our lesson today until next time. Goodbye. *Music* That was social studies lesson for grade 4, the radio presenter was teacher Esther Simaloi The program was written by a social studies media panel. It was produced by the Media and Extension Services and recorded by Johnson Mwangi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time. It's goodbye. *Music*
